title: Helsingin kaupunginvaakuna / History and use
slide_intent: Distinguish ceremonial authority from everyday service identity so viewers can recognize which civic role is being represented.
strategic_value: Separating the historic coat of arms from the framed service logo can preserve the meaning of each.
demonstration: Three numbered Finnish text sections explain the coat of arms history, the 2017 framed logo and permitted heraldic contexts.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate civic symbol before composing a ceremonial or service communication.

content_islands.name: Historical account
content_islands.spec: Upper paragraphs explain the seal, heraldic description and approved model.

content_islands.name: Identity and use
content_islands.spec: Lower numbered sections distinguish the framed logo and restricted crowned coat of arms.

reference_purposes.Application: The numbered sections distinguish everyday framed-logo use from ceremonial heraldic use and identify which users may use the crowned version.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text separates crowned use by central administration from other uses and says the coat of arms and framed logo are not used together.
